notes.title: Ver.1.0.1: Bug Fixes for Online Matches
notes.notes:
The holoReversi Ver.1.0.1 update is now live!

The following issues have been addressed in this update:



/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_

▼ Update Details

・【Online Match – Game Freeze Bug】

Fixed an issue where activating certain skills during online matches could cause the game to become unresponsive.



・【Online Match – Player Name Display Bug】

Fixed a bug where player names appeared as “unknown” during casual matches.



・【Online Match – Game Modes】

In addition to “Score Battle,” players can now also select “Count Battle” and “Classic Reversi.”

Other minor updates



・Some new voice lines have been added.



/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_



Thank you for your continued support of holoReversi!
